title: Discrete cytokine signaling networks instruct distinct synovial pathotypes in inflammatory arthritis
authors: Derrac Soria A; Hill DG; Hughes ST; Scott RN; Cardus Figueras A; Dimonte S; Costa D; Vinh N; Monaco F; Jenkins RH; Liu X; Lewis M; Twohig JP; Guy C; Morrin A; Cossins BC; Andrews R; Szomolay B; Fossati-Jimack L; Nowell MA; Williams AS; Choy EH; Jenkins BJ; Williams NM; Yu H; Kortylewski M; Turner S; Tiganis T; Pitzalis C; Jones GW; Jones SA
one_liner_zh: 该文研究关节炎滑膜病理类型的细胞因子信号网络，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) display distinct patterns of synovitis. To define the inflammatory mechanisms driving this heterogeneity, we analyzed the inflamed synovium of wild-type (WT), Il6ra -/- , and Il27ra -/- mice with antigen-induced arthritis (AIA). Remarkably, each strain developed a joint pathology mirroring a major RA synovial pathotype: myeloid-rich (WT), fibroblast-rich/pauci-immune ( Il6ra -/- ), and lymphoid-rich ( Il27ra -/- ) synovitis. Histology confirmed minimal immune infiltration in Il6ra -/- joints, while WT and Il27ra -/- mice exhibited prominent immune involvement, including organized synovial lymphoid-like aggregates in Il27ra -/- mice. Transcriptomic and epigenomic profiling revealed both shared and distinct regulatory programs among genotypes. Il6ra -/- mice showed increased WNT, DKK, and AMPK signaling associated with fibroblast, chondrocyte, and osteoclast activation (e.g., Adamts19 , Dkk1 , Ecm1 ). Consistent with synovial ectopic lymphoid-like structures, Il27ra -/- mice showed enrichment of lymphocyte activation (e.g., Il17a , Il22 , Bhlhe40 ). WT mice exhibited hallmarks of MAP kinase activation. These molecular signatures parallel those of fibroblast-, lymphoid-, and myeloid-rich synovitis in RA. Defining a STAT1–STAT3 regulatory interplay influencing transcriptional decisions in WT and Il27ra -/- mice, our findings offer insights into cytokine-driven disease heterogeneity. Together, these results establish a framework for mechanism-based classification of synovitis and introduce new mouse models to study the molecular drivers of synovial pathotypes and treatment response.
abstract_zh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）患者表现出不同的滑膜炎模式。为定义驱动这种异质性的炎症机制，我们分析了抗原诱导性关节炎（AIA）的野生型（WT）、Il6ra -/- 和 Il27ra -/- 小鼠的炎症滑膜。值得注意的是，每种品系均发展出与主要RA滑膜病理型相对应的关节病理：髓系丰富型（WT）、成纤维细胞丰富型/少免疫型（ Il6ra -/- ）和淋巴系丰富型（ Il27ra -/- ）滑膜炎。组织学证实 Il6ra -/- 小鼠关节中免疫浸润极少，而WT和 Il27ra -/- 小鼠表现出显著的免疫参与，包括 Il27ra -/- 小鼠中组织化的滑膜淋巴样聚集体。转录组和表观基因组分析揭示了各基因型间共享及独特的调控程序。 Il6ra -/- 小鼠显示WNT、DKK和AMPK信号增强，与成纤维细胞、软骨细胞和破骨细胞活化相关（如 Adamts19 、 Dkk1 、 Ecm1 ）。与滑膜异位淋巴样结构一致， Il27ra -/- 小鼠显示淋巴细胞活化富集（如 Il17a 、 Il22 、 Bhlhe40 ）。WT小鼠表现出MAP激酶活化的标志。通过定义影响WT和 Il27ra -/- 小鼠转录决策的STAT1–STAT3调控相互作用，我们的发现为细胞因子驱动的疾病异质性提供了见解。总之，这些结果建立了基于机制的滑膜炎分类框架，并引入了新的小鼠模型，以研究滑膜病理型和治疗反应的分子驱动因素。
